newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm, Kokusai in CDMA license.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm, Kokusai in CDMA license.

text.p: Qualcomm Inc on Friday said it has signed a licensing agreement with information equipment maker Kokusai Electric Co Ltd for Kokusai to produce and sell digital wireless telecommunications products.
Although financial terms of the deal were not disclosed, Qualcomm did refer to the financial pact as a "multi-million dollar royalty bearing" agreement.
Qualcomm said Kokusai has been granted a patent and technical license to manufacture and sell Code Division Multiple Access, or CDMA, subscriber products.
CDMA systems provide greater call clarity and network capacity than analog systems.

Recently, Japanese government and service providers have moved forward with adoption of CDMA as the next generation of digital wireless communications to meet the expected growth in demand for wireless communications, Qualcomm said.
Kokusai Electric, based in Tokyo, manufactures, markets and sells mobile and wireless communications equipment and semiconductor-related products, including memory chips and electronic components.
